verdict.rationale: AutoGen is an open-source Python framework (pip installable) that runs locally with agent orchestration, tool use, and Docker-based code execution, with no vendor platform dependency required for core agent operation; AutoGen Studio is an optional add-on, not a requirement. Missing for 10: explicit vendor statement on self-hosting/air-gapped deployment guarantees, independent enterprise case studies confirming fully offline/self-hosted production use.
